title: Something's changed
text: Something's changed. I was happy with my first, but, I dropped it and the plastic was cracked.  I ordered another right away and was bummed in that the surface had scratches and a patch  showing silver. It wasn't keeping my coffee warm, either.  I just go another one and the same thing happened.  First time setting cup on it, there was the silver under the black and it's not really keeping my coffee as warm as the first.  Something had to have changed in the manufacturing process.  I will be returning this one too and getting a better one.
